**Boss:** [Wargoyle](#loc=75360)

Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75347: Automatically received after rescuing Quasimodo from Nightmares.
75352: Clear [Special Portal 2](#loc=74667) in La Cité des Cloches as Sora.
75360:
**Weaknesses:** Vanish

Wargoyle can be relentless with its attacks, leaving very few opportunities for Sora to land attacks. 

If you completed The Grid before La Cité des Cloches, Counter Rush is useful to defend yourself. Wargoyle's close-range attacks are more dangerous, so it's recommended to use Flowmotion to stair airborne and out of reach. Also, long-range commands can be used to do damage while keeping your distance.
